reader.requirement: At --std 85 an indexed file named in the USING or GIVING phrase of a SORT or MERGE statement must not have ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM in its file control entry (SEQUENTIAL, DYNAMIC or the omitted clause are legal); all four phrase positions (SORT USING, SORT GIVING, MERGE USING, MERGE GIVING) are covered.
